hero.intro: I build production web applications end to end — from the database and API up to the design system and release. Five years in logistics, enterprise automation and e-commerce; led the full React rewrite of a compliance platform used daily by fleet operators.

about.title: About
about.p1: I live in Tashkent and have been building web products for five years. I started with simple sites and PHP/MySQL server logic; these days I can carry a whole product on my own, from the database up to the interface. On the frontend that means React, TypeScript, Vue and Nuxt; on the backend Python, Node.js and PHP, with data in PostgreSQL or MySQL and everything packaged in Docker.
about.p2: For the last two years I worked on Quantum ELD at Longhorn Logistics, a platform US fleet operators use every day. We moved the old frontend to React + TypeScript + Vite, builds dropped from minutes to seconds and a whole class of stale-data bugs went away. Before that, at Zamonaviy Kommunikatsiyalar, I built CRM, warehouse and transport systems: wrote the APIs in Node.js and PHP, designed the databases myself and shipped the interfaces in Vue.
about.p3: I don't like drawing a line between backend and frontend. Wherever the problem is, that's where I work. In my spare time I send pull requests to Expensify/App; getting through a large team's code review is a school of its own.

experience.title: Experience
experience.subtitle: Five companies, one open-source codebase, and products that are still in daily use.

expensify.summary: Expensify/App — a large open-source financial product maintained by a distributed team (React Native, TypeScript).
highlights: Pick up issues in a large codebase and get fixes merged through the team's strict review process.
Write code that runs on iOS, Android and web at once with React Native, TypeScript and Onyx.
Earned the GitHub Pull Shark and Pair Extraordinaire achievements.

longhorn.summary: Quantum ELD (formerly Green Light ELD) — an Electronic Logging Device platform for fleet operations and FMCSA compliance.
highlights: Led the migration of the legacy frontend to a modern React + TypeScript + Vite stack, replacing the previous build pipeline and cutting local dev rebuilds from minutes to seconds.
Introduced React Query for server-state management and caching, replacing scattered manual fetch logic with a single caching layer and eliminating a recurring class of stale-data bugs.
Rebuilt the UI layer with Tailwind CSS and Radix UI, establishing a shared, accessible design system that made new screens noticeably faster to build.
Improved runtime performance through route-level code-splitting, memoization and render profiling, reducing the initial bundle and unnecessary re-renders on data-heavy screens.
Translated ELD/FMCSA regulatory requirements into UI workflows, working directly with backend and compliance stakeholders.
Delivered a portfolio of enterprise products — CRM platforms, WMS/TMS systems, admin panels and corporate sites — used daily by internal teams and client organizations.
Built scalable frontends with Vue 2, Vue 3, Nuxt 3 and Bootstrap-Vue, owning feature work from specification through release.
Developed backend modules and REST APIs with Node.js and PHP on MySQL/PostgreSQL — schema design, queries and business logic behind CRM and WMS/TMS features — and containerized services with Docker.
Designed reusable component architectures and centralized state with Vuex and Pinia, which became the shared foundation across multiple long-running products.
Maintained and refactored legacy Vue 2 codebases while incrementally migrating modules to the Vue 3 Composition API.

promuz.summary: Remote contract work carried out in parallel with the role above.
highlights: Built e-commerce storefronts with Nuxt 3 and Tailwind CSS, delivering fully responsive layouts across mobile, tablet and desktop.
Developed an admin dashboard for Med24 with its backend API and database, streamlining operations for a medical services provider.
Shipped medical-sector websites on WordPress/PHP with a focus on clear information architecture and accessible interfaces.

datasite.summary: First professional role: client-side web applications and PHP/MySQL server-side logic.
highlights: Developed and supported client-side web applications and PHP/MySQL server-side logic against technical specifications.
Contributed to server maintenance and carried out ongoing refactoring of existing code.
